duration_rules.completion_end: request.dispatch_end_ms if dispatch_returned else null; assigned only on non-error dispatch return
duration_rules.sampling_dispatch_wall_denominator_ms: same completion wall duration (null if unavailable; frame shares null without positive wall denominator)
duration_rules.capture_stop_interleaving: stop disables new trace entries but does not make already executing _trace_inner callbacks atomic; dispatch phase/end/flags are assigned before the lock-protected finished bit. Thus enum alone cannot determine completion-duration nullness for every in-flight callback snapshot.
